== Biography == 
Hans George Reith Sr. was born about 1630, in Bühl, Biberach, Baden-Wuerttemberg, Palatinate, Germany. 

Hans married Margaretha Voltz (1630–1662) about 1652, in Germany. <ref>{{Ancestry Tree|15023964|1844}}.</ref>

He passed away about 1680, in Westrich, Soest, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Germany.<ref>{{Ancestry Tree|770821|6024716560}}.</ref>

Residence Place:  Neckartailfingen, Deutschland. <ref>Württemberg, Germany, Family Tables; FHL Film Number 1056579</ref>

Spouses.Name: McGeough-88
Spouses.bio:
[[Category:Pinjarra, Western Australia]]
[[Category:Perth, Western Australia]]
[[Category:Kanyaka, South Australia]]
[[Category:Karrakatta Cemetery, Karrakatta, Western Australia]]
== Biography ==
{{Australia Sticker|South Australia}}
Catherine Ellen McGeough was born on 9 Sep 1880. She was the daughter of [[McGeough-85|William McGeough]] and [[Corrigan-1570|Ann Corrigan]] Catherine was born at Kanyaka, South Australia<ref>South Australia Birth Index. (GenealogySA, https:www//genealogysa.org.au/index.php: accessed 3 Dec 2023), database entry for McGeough, Catherine (Birth Date: 9 Sep 1880, Father: William McGeough, Mother: Annie Corrigan, Birthplace: Kanyaka), Reference: District: Frome, Book 395 Page 464.</ref>

Catherine married John William Raitt in Perth, Western Australia in 1904. Her marriage registration number was 1467/1904.<ref>Western Australian Online Index (Government of Western Australia; Department of Justice; Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages), Marriage index entry for Catherine Ellen McGeough and John William Raitt, Registration (district: Perth; year: 1904, number: 1467), Details (place of marriage: Perth; year of marriage: 1904), Accessed 31 January 2026, WABMD-marriage-1467/1904.</ref>

Catherine's husband, John Raitt, died on 24 December 1934 in Perth, Western Australia. A newspaper notice was published in the West Australian Newspaper. ''On December 24, John William, loved husband of Catherine Ellen Raitt, at Mount Helena, and fond father of Jessie (Mrs F.J. Bricknell, Kalgoorlie) age 68 years.<ref>RAITT. — On December 24, 1934, John Wil-
liam, loved husband, of Catherine Ellen Raitt, of Mt. Helena, and fond father of Jessie (Mrs. F. J. Bricknell, Kalgoorlie) ; aged 68years. R.I.P.</ref>

Catherine Ellen Raitt, age 81 years, died before 2 March 1962 in Pinjarra, District of Murray, Western Australia.<ref>Western Australian Online Index (Government of Western Australia; Department of Justice; Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages), Death index entry for Catherine Ellen Raitt, Registration (district: Murray; year: 1962; number: 4700013), Details (place of death: Pinjarra; year of death: 1962), Accessed 31 Jan 2026, WABMD-death-1962/4700013.</ref>

Catherine was buried at the Karrakatta Cemetery and Crematorium, Roman Catholic Section, HA 0412. Catherine was interred in the same site as her husband John, who had died in 1934.<ref>Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/201678037/catherine_ellen-raitt: accessed January 31, 2026), memorial page for Catherine Ellen Raitt (unknown–2 Mar 1962), Find a Grave Memorial ID 201678037, citing Karrakatta Cemetery and Crematorium, Karrakatta, City of Nedlands, Western Australia, Australia; Maintained by jlong (contributor 48741020).</ref>
